data.one_liner: Generative AI library for Dart and Flutter supporting text generation, tools, and flows.
data.what_it_does: Genkit provides a unified interface for building production-ready AI applications in Dart. It supports text generation, streaming, embeddings, tool calling, flows, and middleware for client and server apps.
use_when: You need a unified framework for interacting with LLMs like Gemini in Dart.
You want to build agentic workflows, define custom tools, and handle streaming responses.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, single-purpose wrapper for a specific vendor like OpenAI without a framework.
You do not plan to use generative AI features in your application.
strengths: Unified API across models and providers.
Built-in support for streaming, interrupts, and middleware.
Comes with a local developer UI and tracing tools.
weaknesses: Requires learning Genkit's specific framework and abstractions.
Depends on plugins for specific AI backends like Google GenAI.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the genkit package, registering plugins like genkit_google_genai, and setting up necessary API keys (e.g., GEMINI_API_KEY).

alternatives.name: openai_dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are specifically targeting OpenAI models and prefer a direct client library instead of Genkit's larger framework.

alternatives.name: ollama_dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to integrate specifically with local Ollama instances.
